article.title: “Sharia cannot be placed above Constitution; citizenship also comes with duties”: VHP’s Vijay Shankar Tiwari
article.summary: NEW DELHI: The Vishva Hindu Parishad has strongly opposed the “Constitution and Sharia Protection Movement” announced by the All-India Muslim Personal Law Board. VHP Central Joint Secretary Vijay Shankar Tiwari said India is a constitutional nation where the Constitution is supreme, not Sharia. Tiwari said organisations that invoke the Constitution while placing Sharia on an equal footing with it are “playing with the unity of the country”. Addressing the Muslim community, Tiwari said Muslims in India are Indian citizens and enjoy all rights guaranteed by the Constitution. However, he said citizenship also comes with duties. Accepting the laws of the country, respecting national symbols and understanding the spirit of the Uniform Civil Code are also part of citizenship, he added.
